facts.fact: Ecofin (19 May 2026) says WIOCC, through its open-access data centre arm OADC, operates data centres in the DRC, with Kinshasa among its sites in 2024 energy figures; no facility name, tier or capacity for the DRC alone is given.

note: Financing story; the as_of is the article date, as no opening date is given. Planned Lagos and South Africa items are other countries.
